title: Introducing Animate It, a New Way to Create Personalized Videos From Any Prompt
summary: Today, we’re offering a new way for you to take your creativity to an entirely new dimension with our first open prompt video generation Lens: Animate It.
body_markdown:
Snapchat is all about helping you express yourself in new and magical ways — and today, we’re offering a new way for you to take your creativity to an entirely new dimension with our first open prompt video generation Lens: Animate It.


Available for Lens+ subscribers, the Animate It Lens leverages Snap’s internally developed AI video generation model to turn your ideas into short, shareable videos in seconds.


Whether you want to animate a reaction, dream up a mini-movie, or turn a playful idea into a dynamic clip, Animate It allows you to create motion from pure imagination.


Getting started is simple:


-


Search for Animate It from the Camera


-


Select the Lens then tap the caption to enter your own idea or choose from one of our suggested prompts


-


Watch your concept transform into a personalized video. In just a few seconds, you’ll have a one-of-a-kind animated creation ready to share anywhere on Snapchat or beyond.


As one of the most dynamic AI-powered experiences we’ve built yet — and the first video generation Lens on Snapchat — we can’t wait to see the moments, reactions, and stories you bring to life ✨🎥
